051/**
052 * Facade orchestrating an OpenID Connect Authorization-Code-with-PKCE <i>Relying Party</i> login flow on
053 * top of the {@code juneau-rest-server-auth-oauth} building blocks.
054 *
055 * <p>
056 * A single instance wires the login / callback / logout endpoints plus the session SPI for one IdP.  The
057 * application mounts the three endpoints as explicit {@code @RestGet} methods that delegate to this
058 * facade &mdash; there are no auto-mounted servlet routes (URL ownership stays with the app):
059 *
060 * <p class='bjava'>
061 *    <ja>@Rest</ja>(path=<js>"/auth"</js>)
062 *    <jk>public class</jk> LoginResource <jk>extends</jk> BasicRestServlet {
063 *
064 *       <jk>private final</jk> OidcRelyingParty <jf>rp</jf> = OidcRelyingParty.<jsm>create</jsm>()
065 *          .issuer(URI.<jsm>create</jsm>(<js>"https://accounts.google.com"</js>))
066 *          .clientId(<js>"web-app"</js>)
067 *          .clientSecret(<jv>env</jv>(<js>"OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET"</js>))
068 *          .redirectUri(URI.<jsm>create</jsm>(<js>"https://app.example.com/auth/callback"</js>))
069 *          .scope(<js>"openid"</js>, <js>"profile"</js>, <js>"email"</js>)
070 *          .sessionStore(SignedCookieSessionStore.<jsm>create</jsm>().signingKey(<jv>env</jv>(<js>"SESSION_KEY"</js>)).build())
071 *          .build();
072 *
073 *       <ja>@RestGet</ja>(path=<js>"/login"</js>)
074 *       <jk>public void</jk> login(RestRequest <jv>req</jv>, RestResponse <jv>res</jv>) <jk>throws</jk> Exception {
075 *          <jf>rp</jf>.startLogin(<jv>req</jv>, <jv>res</jv>);
076 *       }
077 *
078 *       <ja>@RestGet</ja>(path=<js>"/callback"</js>)
079 *       <jk>public void</jk> callback(RestRequest <jv>req</jv>, RestResponse <jv>res</jv>) <jk>throws</jk> Exception {
080 *          <jf>rp</jf>.completeLogin(<jv>req</jv>, <jv>res</jv>);
081 *       }
082 *
083 *       <ja>@RestGet</ja>(path=<js>"/logout"</js>)
084 *       <jk>public void</jk> logout(RestRequest <jv>req</jv>, RestResponse <jv>res</jv>) <jk>throws</jk> Exception {
085 *          <jf>rp</jf>.logout(<jv>req</jv>, <jv>res</jv>);
086 *       }
087 *    }
088 * </p>
089 *
090 * <p>
091 * Register {@link #authFilter()} in the servlet filter chain (or {@code AuthFilterChain}) so each request
092 * resolves the session cookie into a {@link ClaimsPrincipal} for {@code RoleBasedRestGuard} /
093 * {@code @Auth Principal}.
094 *
095 * <h5 class='section'>Security</h5>
096 * <ul>
097 *    <li>{@code state} and {@code nonce} are single-use and TTL-bounded (default 5&nbsp;min); a
098 *       missing / replayed value fails the callback.
099 *    <li>PKCE S256 is enforced end-to-end.
100 *    <li>The ID token is validated for signature, {@code iss}, {@code aud}/{@code azp}, {@code exp}, and
101 *       {@code nonce} (see {@link IdTokenValidatorAdapter}).
102 *    <li>The session id is freshly generated on login (no pre-auth fixation).
103 *    <li>Auth responses set {@code Cache-Control: no-store}; tokens are never logged.
104 *    <li>The session cookie is {@code HttpOnly} + {@code Secure} + {@code SameSite} by default.
105 * </ul>
106 *
107 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
108 *    <li class='jc'>{@link SessionStore}
109 *    <li class='jc'>{@link OidcSessionAuthFilter}
110 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/OidcRelyingParty">OIDC Relying Party</a>
111 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://openid.net/specs/openid-connect-core-1_0.html">OpenID Connect Core 1.0</a>
112 * </ul>
113 *
114 * @since 10.0.0
115 */
116@SuppressWarnings({
117   "java:S1192" // Duplicate string literals are OIDC protocol parameter names and claim names; intentional
118})

167      /**
168       * Sets the IdP issuer URL.  OIDC discovery resolves the endpoints + JWKS URI lazily.  Either
169       * this or {@link #metadata(OidcMetadata)} is required.
170       *
171       * <p>
172       * The issuer (and every endpoint discovered from it) must use <js>"https"</js> or target a loopback
173       * host; discovery, JWKS, and token exchanges carry trust-anchor key material and client credentials, so
174       * a plaintext transport to a non-loopback host is rejected.
175       *
176       * @param value The issuer URL.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> and must use HTTPS or target a loopback host.
177       * @return This object.
178       */
179      public Builder issuer(URI value) {
180         issuer = UriUtils.assertSecureOrLoopback(assertArgNotNull("value", value));
181         return this;
182      }

189       * @return This object.
190       */

471      /**
472       * Builds the relying party.
473       *
474       * @return A new {@link OidcRelyingParty}.
475       */
476      public OidcRelyingParty build() {
477         if (issuer == null && metadata == null)
478            throw new IllegalStateException("OidcRelyingParty requires issuer(...) or metadata(...)");
479         if (clientId == null)
480            throw new IllegalStateException("OidcRelyingParty requires clientId(...)");
481         if (redirectUri == null)
482            throw new IllegalStateException("OidcRelyingParty requires redirectUri(...)");
483         if (sessionStore == null)
484            throw new IllegalStateException("OidcRelyingParty requires sessionStore(...)");
485         return new OidcRelyingParty(this);
486      }

535   /**
536    * Constructor.
537    *
538    * @param b The builder.
539    */
540   protected OidcRelyingParty(Builder b) {
541      this.issuer = b.issuer;
542      this.explicitMetadata = b.metadata;
543      this.clientId = b.clientId;
544      this.clientSecretSupplier = b.clientSecretSupplier;
545      this.redirectUri = b.redirectUri;
546      this.postLogoutRedirectUri = b.postLogoutRedirectUri;
547      this.postLoginRedirect = b.postLoginRedirect;
548      var s = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
549      s.add("openid");
550      s.addAll(b.scopes);
551      this.scopes = u(s);
552      this.sessionStore = b.sessionStore;
553      this.rolesClaim = b.rolesClaim;
554      this.sessionTtl = b.sessionTtl;
555      this.cookieName = b.cookieName;
556      this.cookieSecure = b.cookieSecure;
557      this.cookieHttpOnly = b.cookieHttpOnly;
558      this.cookieSameSite = b.cookieSameSite;
559      this.httpRequestConfigurator = b.httpRequestConfigurator;
560      this.authenticationRequestCustomizer = b.authenticationRequestCustomizer;
561      this.idTokenAlgorithms = b.idTokenAlgorithms;
562      this.clockSkewSeconds = b.clockSkewSeconds;
563      this.jwkSet = b.jwkSet;
564      this.injectedJwkSource = b.jwkSource;
565      this.userInfoClaims = u(cp(b.userInfoClaims));
566      this.clock = b.clock;
567      this.ephemeralStore = new EphemeralStore(b.stateNonceTtl, b.ephemeralMaxEntries, b.clock);
568   }

570   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
571   // Public flow methods
572   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
573
574   /**
575    * Begins the login flow: generates {@code state} + {@code nonce} + PKCE verifier, stores them
576    * single-use, and redirects the user-agent to the IdP authorization endpoint.
577    *
578    * @param req The HTTP request.  An optional {@code redirect} query parameter (a safe relative path)
579    *    is remembered as the post-login target.
580    * @param res The HTTP response.
581    * @throws IOException If the redirect cannot be written.
582    */
583   public void startLogin(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res) throws IOException {
584      assertArgNotNull("req", req);
585      assertArgNotNull("res", res);
586      var state = new State().getValue();
587      var nonce = new Nonce().getValue();
588      var verifier = new CodeVerifier();
589      var challenge = CodeChallenge.compute(CodeChallengeMethod.S256, verifier);
590      var redirectTarget = safeRelativePath(req.getParameter("redirect"));
591      ephemeralStore.store(state, nonce, verifier.getValue(), redirectTarget);
592      var authUrl = codeFlow().buildAuthenticationUrl(state, challenge, nonce, authenticationRequestCustomizer);
593      noStore(res);
594      res.sendRedirect(authUrl.toString());
595   }
596
597   /**
598    * Completes the login flow: parses the callback, verifies + consumes {@code state}, exchanges the
599    * code (PKCE), validates the ID token (signature / {@code iss} / {@code aud} / {@code exp} /
600    * {@code nonce}), creates a session, sets the session cookie, and redirects to the application.
601    *
602    * @param req The callback HTTP request (carrying {@code code} + {@code state}).
603    * @param res The HTTP response.
604    * @throws IOException If the redirect cannot be written.
605    * @throws AuthenticationException If the callback is an error, the state is missing / replayed, or
606    *    ID-token validation fails.
607    */
608   public void completeLogin(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res) throws IOException, AuthenticationException {
609      assertArgNotNull("req", req);
610      assertArgNotNull("res", res);
611
612      var callbackUri = fullRequestUri(req);
613      AuthenticationResponse parsed;
614      try {
615         parsed = AuthenticationResponseParser.parse(callbackUri);
616      } catch (com.nimbusds.oauth2.sdk.ParseException e) {
617         throw new AuthenticationException(e, "OIDC callback could not be parsed");
618      }
619      if (! parsed.indicatesSuccess()) {
620         var err = parsed.toErrorResponse().getErrorObject();
621         throw new AuthenticationException("OIDC callback returned an error: %s", err == null ? "unknown" : err.getCode()); // HTT: err==null branch requires an error response with no error object, which Nimbus never produces
622      }
623      var success = parsed.toSuccessResponse();
624      if (success.getAuthorizationCode() == null)
625         throw new AuthenticationException("OIDC callback contained no authorization code");
626      var code = success.getAuthorizationCode().getValue();
627      var state = success.getState() == null ? null : success.getState().getValue(); // HTT: null state branch: AuthCode response always carries state per PKCE flow; null branch is defensive dead code
628
629      var pending = ephemeralStore.consume(state).orElseThrow(
630         () -> new AuthenticationException("OIDC callback state is missing, expired, or already used"));
631
632      OAuthToken token;
633      try {
634         token = codeFlow().exchange(code, new CodeVerifier(pending.codeVerifier()));
635      } catch (OAuthFlowException e) {
636         throw new AuthenticationException(e, "OIDC token exchange failed");
637      }
638      var idToken = token.idToken().orElseThrow(
639         () -> new AuthenticationException("IdP token response contained no id_token"));
640
641      var principal = idTokenValidator().validate(idToken, pending.nonce());
642      principal = maybeBackfillUserInfo(principal, token);
643
644      var subject = principal.getName();
645      var sid = principal.getClaim("sid", String.class);
646      var roles = extractRoles(principal);
647      var now = clock.instant();
648      var session = new OidcSession(
649         new State().getValue(),
650         subject,
651         sid,
652         principal,
653         roles,
654         o(token),
655         now,
656         now.plus(sessionTtl));
657
658      var cookieValue = sessionStore.createSessionCookieValue(session);
659      noStore(res);
660      res.addHeader("Set-Cookie", buildSetCookie(cookieValue, sessionTtl.toSeconds()));
661      res.sendRedirect(or(pending.redirectTarget(), postLoginRedirect));
662   }
663
664   /**
665    * Logs the user out: invalidates the session, clears the session cookie, and (when the IdP
666    * advertises an end-session endpoint) redirects through it; otherwise redirects to the
667    * post-logout target.
668    *
669    * @param req The HTTP request.
670    * @param res The HTTP response.
671    * @throws IOException If the redirect cannot be written.
672    */
673   public void logout(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res) throws IOException {
674      assertArgNotNull("req", req);
675      assertArgNotNull("res", res);
676      var cookieValue = readCookie(req);
677      JWT idTokenHint = null;
678      if (cookieValue != null) {
679         idTokenHint = idTokenHintFromSession(cookieValue);
680         sessionStore.invalidate(cookieValue);
681      }
682      noStore(res);
683      res.addHeader("Set-Cookie", buildSetCookie("", 0));
684
685      var endSession = metadata().endSessionEndpoint();
686      if (endSession != null) {
687         var logoutReq = new LogoutRequest(endSession, idTokenHint, postLogoutRedirectUri, null);
688         res.sendRedirect(logoutReq.toURI().toString());
689      } else {
690         res.sendRedirect(postLogoutRedirectUri != null ? postLogoutRedirectUri.toString() : postLoginRedirect);
691      }
692   }

694   /**
695    * Refreshes the current session's access token using the rotating-refresh-token grant.
696    *
697    * <p>
698    * Replaces the stored refresh token with the one the IdP returns; if the IdP rejects the refresh
699    * (e.g. a rotated token was reused / revoked), the session is invalidated.  Only applies to stores
700    * that retain tokens (server-side); {@link SignedCookieSessionStore} sessions carry no tokens and
701    * yield {@link Optional#empty()}.
702    *
703    * @param req The HTTP request.
704    * @param res The HTTP response (a refreshed session resets the cookie).
705    * @return The refreshed session, or {@link Optional#empty()} if there was nothing to refresh.
706    */
707   public Optional<OidcSession> refresh(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res) {
708      assertArgNotNull("req", req);
709      assertArgNotNull("res", res);
710      var cookieValue = readCookie(req);
711      if (cookieValue == null)
712         return oe();
713      var existing = sessionStore.lookup(cookieValue);
714      if (existing.isEmpty())
715         return oe();
716      var tokenOpt = existing.get().token();
717      if (tokenOpt.isEmpty())
718         return oe();
719      var oldToken = tokenOpt.get();
720      var refreshTokenOpt = oldToken.refreshToken();
721      if (refreshTokenOpt.isEmpty())
722         return oe();
723
724      OAuthToken refreshed;
725      try {
726         var flowBuilder = OAuthRefreshTokenFlow.create()
727            .tokenEndpoint(metadata().tokenEndpoint())
728            .clientId(clientId)
729            .refreshToken(refreshTokenOpt.get());
730         if (clientSecretSupplier != null) // HTT: false branch (null secret = public client) reachable via refresh path only; no dedicated public-client refresh test
731            flowBuilder.clientSecretSupplier(clientSecretSupplier);
732         if (httpRequestConfigurator != null) // HTT: false branch (no configurator) unreachable in current refresh tests because the test RP always omits a configurator, so this block is never entered in tests
733            flowBuilder.httpRequestConfigurator(httpRequestConfigurator);
734         refreshed = flowBuilder.build().acquire();
735      } catch (OAuthFlowException e) {
736         // Rotating-refresh-token reuse / revocation -> invalidate the session (fail-closed).
737         sessionStore.invalidate(cookieValue);
738         res.addHeader("Set-Cookie", buildSetCookie("", 0));
739         return oe();
740      }
741
742      var old = existing.get();
743      var now = clock.instant();
744      var newSession = new OidcSession(
745         new State().getValue(),
746         old.subject(),
747         old.sid(),
748         old.principal(),
749         old.roles(),
750         o(refreshed),
751         old.createdAt(),
752         now.plus(sessionTtl));
753      sessionStore.invalidate(cookieValue);
754      var newCookie = sessionStore.createSessionCookieValue(newSession);
755      noStore(res);
756      res.addHeader("Set-Cookie", buildSetCookie(newCookie, sessionTtl.toSeconds()));
757      return o(newSession);
758   }

760   /**
761    * Processes an IdP-pushed OpenID Connect back-channel logout token, invalidating the matching
762    * server-side session(s).
763    *
764    * <p>
765    * The logout token is validated via Nimbus's {@link LogoutTokenValidator} (signature against the
766    * JWKS, {@code iss}, {@code aud}, the back-channel {@code events} claim, and the {@code sub} /
767    * {@code sid} presence rule).  Sessions are then revoked by {@code sid} (preferred, single-session)
768    * or {@code sub} (all of a subject's sessions).
769    *
770    * <p>
771    * Requires a {@link SessionStore#supportsServerSideRevocation() server-side-revocable} store
772    * &mdash; the default {@link SignedCookieSessionStore} cannot satisfy back-channel logout because a
773    * stateless cookie is not server-revocable.
774    *
775    * @param logoutToken The raw {@code logout_token} JWT pushed by the IdP.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>
776    *    or blank.
777    * @return The number of sessions invalidated.
778    * @throws AuthenticationException If the logout token fails validation.
779    * @throws IllegalStateException If the configured session store does not support server-side
780    *    revocation.
781    */
782   public int backChannelLogout(String logoutToken) throws AuthenticationException {
783      assertArgNotNullOrBlank("logoutToken", logoutToken);
784      if (! sessionStore.supportsServerSideRevocation())
785         throw new IllegalStateException("Back-channel logout requires a server-side-revocable SessionStore (InMemorySessionStore or a distributed store); the configured store is stateless.");
786      JWT jwt;
787      try {
788         jwt = JWTParser.parse(logoutToken);
789      } catch (java.text.ParseException e) {
790         throw new AuthenticationException(e, "Logout token could not be parsed");
791      }
792      LogoutTokenClaimsSet claims;
793      try {
794         var verified = logoutTokenProcessor().process(jwt, null);
795         claims = new LogoutTokenClaimsSet(verified);
796      } catch (com.nimbusds.jose.proc.BadJOSEException | com.nimbusds.jose.JOSEException e) {
797         throw new AuthenticationException(e, "Logout token validation failed: %s", e.getMessage());
798      } catch (com.nimbusds.oauth2.sdk.ParseException e) {
799         throw new AuthenticationException(e, "Logout token claims could not be parsed");
800      }
801      var sid = claims.getSessionID();
802      if (sid != null)
803         return sessionStore.invalidateBySessionId(sid.getValue());
804      var sub = claims.getSubject();
805      if (sub != null) // HTT: false branch (sub==null with sid==null) rejected by LogoutTokenClaimsVerifier which requires at least one of sub or sid; defensive dead code
806         return sessionStore.invalidateBySubject(sub.getValue());
807      return 0;
808   }

842   private OidcMetadata metadata() {
843      var m = metadataCache;
844      if (m != null)
845         return m;
846      synchronized (this) {
847         if (metadataCache != null) // HTT: DCL second-check; true branch requires concurrent initialization race
848            return metadataCache;
849         if (explicitMetadata != null) { // HTT: false branch = discovery path; all tests inject .metadata(...) directly so explicitMetadata is always non-null
850            metadataCache = validateEndpoints(explicitMetadata);
851            return metadataCache;
852         }
853         try {
854            var clientBuilder = OidcDiscoveryClient.create().issuer(issuer);
855            if (httpRequestConfigurator != null) // HTT: true branch requires discovery path (no explicit metadata) plus httpRequestConfigurator; all tests inject metadata directly
856               clientBuilder.httpRequestConfigurator(httpRequestConfigurator);
857            metadataCache = validateEndpoints(clientBuilder.build().discover());
858         } catch (IOException | OidcDiscoveryException e) {
859            throw isex(e, "OIDC discovery failed for issuer %s", issuer);
860         }
861         return metadataCache;
862      }
863   }
864
865   /**
866    * Requires the token-bearing endpoints resolved from metadata (issuer, token, JWKS) to use https or a
867    * loopback host, so key material and client credentials are never exchanged over plaintext to a remote host.
868    */
869   private static OidcMetadata validateEndpoints(OidcMetadata m) {
870      if (m.issuer() != null) // HTT: null issuer unreachable; OIDC metadata always carries an issuer
871         UriUtils.assertSecureOrLoopback(m.issuer());
872      if (m.tokenEndpoint() != null)
873         UriUtils.assertSecureOrLoopback(m.tokenEndpoint());
874      if (m.jwksUri() != null)
875         UriUtils.assertSecureOrLoopback(m.jwksUri());
876      return m;
877   }

879   private OAuthAuthorizationCodeFlow codeFlow() {
880      var f = codeFlowCache;
881      if (f != null)
882         return f;
883      synchronized (this) {
884         if (codeFlowCache != null) // HTT: DCL second-check; true branch requires concurrent initialization race
885            return codeFlowCache;
886         var md = metadata();
887         var b = OAuthAuthorizationCodeFlow.create()
888            .authorizationEndpoint(md.authorizationEndpoint())
889            .tokenEndpoint(md.tokenEndpoint())
890            .clientId(clientId)
891            .redirectUri(redirectUri)
892            .scope(scopes.toArray(new String[0]));
893         if (clientSecretSupplier != null) // HTT: false branch (public client with no secret) not covered; all test RPs set a client secret
894            b.clientSecretSupplier(clientSecretSupplier);
895         if (httpRequestConfigurator != null) // HTT: false branch not hit in codeFlow init; test RPs don't set an httpRequestConfigurator
896            b.httpRequestConfigurator(httpRequestConfigurator);
897         codeFlowCache = b.build();
898         return codeFlowCache;
899      }
900   }

902   private IdTokenValidatorAdapter idTokenValidator() {
903      var v = idTokenValidatorCache;
904      if (v != null)
905         return v;
906      synchronized (this) {
907         if (idTokenValidatorCache != null) // HTT: DCL second-check; true branch requires concurrent initialization race
908            return idTokenValidatorCache;
909         var b = IdTokenValidatorAdapter.create()
910            .issuer(metadata().issuer().toString())
911            .clientId(clientId)
912            .jwkSource(jwkSource())
913            .maxClockSkewSeconds(clockSkewSeconds);
914         if (idTokenAlgorithms != null) // HTT: false branch (custom algorithm list) not covered; test RPs use default RS256/ES256
915            b.algorithms(idTokenAlgorithms);
916         idTokenValidatorCache = b.build();
917         return idTokenValidatorCache;
918      }
919   }

921   private JWKSource<SecurityContext> jwkSource() {
922      var s = jwkSourceCache;
923      if (s != null)
924         return s;
925      synchronized (this) {
926         if (jwkSourceCache != null) // HTT: DCL second-check; true branch requires concurrent initialization race
927            return jwkSourceCache;
928         if (injectedJwkSource != null) { // HTT: true branch requires jwkSource(JWKSource) builder call, which no current test uses (tests inject jwkSet instead)
929            jwkSourceCache = injectedJwkSource;
930         } else if (jwkSet != null) { // HTT: false branch (no jwkSet → use JWKS URI from discovery) requires a live IdP and no injected jwkSet; all tests inject jwkSet
931            jwkSourceCache = new ImmutableJWKSet<>(jwkSet);
932         } else {
933            try {
934               jwkSourceCache = JWKSourceBuilder.create(metadata().jwksUri().toURL()).build();
935            } catch (MalformedURLException e) {
936               throw isex(e, "Invalid JWKS URI: %s", metadata().jwksUri());
937            }
938         }
939         return jwkSourceCache;
940      }
941   }

943   /**
944    * Builds (and caches) the JWT processor used to validate back-channel logout tokens.
945    *
946    * <p>
947    * Nimbus's {@link LogoutTokenValidator} hardcodes a {@link LogoutTokenClaimsVerifier} internally and
948    * exposes no clock hook, so we drive an equivalent {@link DefaultJWTProcessor} directly: the JWS type
949    * verifier replicates {@code LogoutTokenValidator}'s default (accept untyped, {@code logout+jwt}, or
950    * {@code JWT}), and the claims verifier is a {@link ClockAwareLogoutTokenClaimsVerifier} that sources
951    * "now" from {@link #clock}.  With {@link Clock#systemUTC()} the behavior is identical to stock
952    * {@code LogoutTokenValidator}.
953    */
954   private ConfigurableJWTProcessor<SecurityContext> logoutTokenProcessor() {
955      var p = logoutTokenProcessorCache;
956      if (p != null)
957         return p;
958      synchronized (this) {
959         if (logoutTokenProcessorCache != null) // HTT: DCL second-check; true branch requires concurrent initialization race
960            return logoutTokenProcessorCache;
961         Set<JWSAlgorithm> algs = idTokenAlgorithms != null
962            ? new LinkedHashSet<>(Arrays.asList(idTokenAlgorithms))
963            : new LinkedHashSet<>(Arrays.asList(JWSAlgorithm.RS256, JWSAlgorithm.ES256));
964         var keySelector = new JWSVerificationKeySelector<SecurityContext>(algs, jwkSource());
965         var expectedIssuer = new Issuer(metadata().issuer().toString());
966         var processor = new DefaultJWTProcessor<SecurityContext>();
967         processor.setJWSTypeVerifier(new DefaultJOSEObjectTypeVerifier<>(LogoutTokenValidator.TYPE, JOSEObjectType.JWT, null));
968         processor.setJWSKeySelector(keySelector);
969         @SuppressWarnings("unchecked") // ClockAwareLogoutTokenClaimsVerifier conforms to JWTClaimsSetVerifier<SecurityContext>; Nimbus's raw type forces an unchecked conversion here.
970         JWTClaimsSetVerifier<SecurityContext> claimsVerifier = new ClockAwareLogoutTokenClaimsVerifier(expectedIssuer, new ClientID(clientId), clock);
971         processor.setJWTClaimsSetVerifier(claimsVerifier);
972         logoutTokenProcessorCache = processor;
973         return logoutTokenProcessorCache;
974      }
975   }
976
977   private ClaimsPrincipal maybeBackfillUserInfo(ClaimsPrincipal principal, OAuthToken token) {
978      if (userInfoClaims.isEmpty())
979         return principal;
980      var endpoint = metadata().userinfoEndpoint();
981      if (endpoint == null)
982         return principal;
983      var missing = userInfoClaims.stream().anyMatch(c -> ! principal.hasClaim(c));
984      if (! missing)
985         return principal;
986      try {
987         var http = new UserInfoRequest(endpoint, new BearerAccessToken(token.accessToken())).toHTTPRequest();
988         if (httpRequestConfigurator != null)
989            httpRequestConfigurator.accept(http);
990         var resp = UserInfoResponse.parse(http.send());
991         if (! resp.indicatesSuccess())
992            return principal;
993         var ui = resp.toSuccessResponse().getUserInfo().toJSONObject();
994         var merged = new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>(principal.getClaims());
995         for (var c : userInfoClaims)
996            if (! merged.containsKey(c) && ui.containsKey(c))
997               merged.put(c, ui.get(c));
998         return new ClaimsPrincipal(principal.getName(), merged);
999      } catch (IOException | com.nimbusds.oauth2.sdk.ParseException | RuntimeException e) {
1000         return principal;  // UserInfo backfill is best-effort; never fail the login on it.
1001      }
1002   }
1003
1004   private Set<String> extractRoles(ClaimsPrincipal principal) {
1005      var v = principal.getClaims().get(rolesClaim);
1006      if (v == null)
1007         return Collections.emptySet();
1008      var out = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
1009      if (v instanceof String v2) {
1010         for (var piece : v2.split("\\s+"))
1011            if (! piece.isBlank())
1012               out.add(piece);
1013      } else if (v instanceof Collection<?> v2) {
1014         for (var item : v2)
1015            if (item instanceof String item2)
1016               out.add(item2);
1017      }
1018      return out;
1019   }

1021   private String buildSetCookie(String value, long maxAgeSeconds) {
1022      var sb = new StringBuilder();
1023      sb.append(cookieName).append('=').append(value);
1024      sb.append("; Path=/");
1025      sb.append("; Max-Age=").append(maxAgeSeconds);
1026      if (cookieHttpOnly)
1027         sb.append("; HttpOnly");
1028      if (cookieSecure)
1029         sb.append("; Secure");
1030      if (cookieSameSite != null) // HTT: false branch requires null cookieSameSite, which the builder's assertArgNotNullOrBlank guard prevents
1031         sb.append("; SameSite=").append(cookieSameSite);
1032      return sb.toString();
1033   }

1035   /**
1036    * Best-effort extraction of the {@code id_token_hint} for the RP-initiated logout request from the
1037    * session referenced by the given cookie value.  Returns <jk>null</jk> when the session, its token,
1038    * or its id_token is absent, or when the id_token cannot be parsed.
1039    */
1040   private JWT idTokenHintFromSession(String cookieValue) {
1041      var session = sessionStore.lookup(cookieValue);
1042      if (session.isEmpty())
1043         return null;
1044      var token = session.get().token();
1045      if (token.isEmpty())
1046         return null;
1047      var idt = token.get().idToken();
1048      if (idt.isEmpty()) // HTT: requires OAuthToken with no id_token; code-exchange always produces one when idToken is set on the stub, and the field is final
1049         return null;
1050      try {
1051         return JWTParser.parse(idt.get());
1052      } catch (java.text.ParseException e) {
1053         return null;  // HTT - best-effort hint only
1054      }
1055   }
1056
1057   private String readCookie(HttpServletRequest req) {
1058      var cookies = req.getCookies();
1059      if (cookies == null)
1060         return null;
1061      for (var c : cookies)
1062         if (cookieName.equals(c.getName()) && c.getValue() != null && ! c.getValue().isBlank())
1063            return c.getValue();
1064      return null;
1065   }

1067   private static void noStore(HttpServletResponse res) {
1068      res.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store");
1069      res.setHeader("Pragma", "no-cache");
1070   }

1072   private static URI fullRequestUri(HttpServletRequest req) {
1073      var url = new StringBuilder(req.getRequestURL());
1074      var qs = req.getQueryString();
1075      if (qs != null) // HTT: false branch (no QS) would cause Nimbus to fail to parse the callback; all test callbacks include query params
1076         url.append('?').append(qs);
1077      return URI.create(url.toString());
1078   }

1080   /**
1081    * Returns the value only if it is a safe app-relative path (defeats open-redirect via the
1082    * {@code redirect} parameter).
1083    */
1084   private static String safeRelativePath(String value) {
1085      if (isBlank(value))
1086         return null;
1087      if (! value.startsWith("/"))
1088         return null;
1089      if (value.startsWith("//") || value.contains("\\") || value.contains("://"))
1090         return null;
1091      return value;
1092   }

1094   /**
1095    * A {@link LogoutTokenClaimsVerifier} whose {@code exp} window is evaluated against an injected
1096    * {@link Clock} instead of {@code new Date()}.
1097    *
1098    * <p>
1099    * {@link LogoutTokenClaimsVerifier} extends Nimbus's {@link DefaultJWTClaimsVerifier}, which exposes
1100    * an overridable {@link DefaultJWTClaimsVerifier#currentTime() currentTime()} hook &mdash; so this is
1101    * a one-method override that injects the clock without cloning any Nimbus claim-checking logic.  With
1102    * {@link Clock#systemUTC()} the behavior is identical to stock Nimbus.
1103    */
1104   private static final class ClockAwareLogoutTokenClaimsVerifier extends LogoutTokenClaimsVerifier {
1105
1106      private final Clock clock;
1107
1108      ClockAwareLogoutTokenClaimsVerifier(Issuer issuer, ClientID clientId, Clock clock) {
1109         super(issuer, clientId);
1110         this.clock = clock;
1111      }
1112
1113      @Override /* DefaultJWTClaimsVerifier */
1114      protected Date currentTime() {
1115         return Date.from(clock.instant());
1116      }
1117   }
